description: Golden parity for the external validation-submit v1 mapper: (id, status, completedAt) -> ExternalValidationResultV1. Asserted IDENTICALLY by the REAL TS toExternalValidationResultV1 (tests/external-vendor/validation-result-v1-fixtures.test.ts) and the C# ExternalValidationResultV1.Map (Tims.UnitTests). A structural map only: constant schemaVersion 'v1' + value passthrough. The completedAt date MUST be the canonical Node toISOString() '…fffZ' string, byte-identical across both stacks (the C# side serializes through NodeIsoDateTimeOffsetConverter).

cases.name: failed submission -> v1 (fractional milliseconds preserved as .fffZ)
